marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to northwest 15 knots late overnight then
veering to north 20 Friday afternoon. Rain beginning this evening changing to scattered showers
near noon Friday and ending Friday afternoon. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
rain. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early Friday
afternoon.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
